displayName: OCI-AI-DB-022: AI — Model Serving Infrastructure Compromise
description:
Detects compromise of model serving infrastructure through unauthorized container or API access

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_db_022", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%model%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%serving%') AND "value" > 0
